blocks.en: An important class of nonlinear elliptic PDEs arise from problems in the calculus of variations. We will focus on a particularly vital set of representatives of this class: problems describing the equilibrium of \emph{elastic} materials. In discussing this class of problems we will be able to examine not only many of the classical techniques for elliptic problems from the calculus of variations, but also some important techniques which have been developed over the last twenty years.
blocks.zh: 一类重要的非线性椭圆 PDE 来源于变分法中的问题. 我们将着重讨论这一类中一组尤为重要的代表: 描述\emph{弹性}材料平衡的问题. 在讨论这类问题时, 我们不仅能够考察变分法中处理椭圆问题的许多经典技术, 还能够考察过去二十年间发展起来的一些重要技术.
